desc:
Secure. Contain. Protect.

SCP: Site-81 Roleplay is a hybridized game set in the universe of "SCP: Containment Breach," by Undertow Games, that combines gameplay of both casual SCP roleplay games, as well as group based SCPFs. 

As a member of the Foundation, your goals are simple; do your job, keep your head down, and you might live to see tomorrow. As a member of the disposable Class-D test subjects, find your way out of the facility - or die trying. As a member of the Chaos Insurgency, make the Foundation pay by wreaking total havoc upon the facility.

SCP: Site-81 Roleplay is still in development, and feedback in our social channels is always appreciated. All links can be found in our associated group.

WARNING: This game has minor flashing lights. If you are particularly photo-sensitive, you may want to consider disabling the light particle effects in the main menu, especially if you play on graphics settings lower than 10.

Current game version: v0.4b.0-alpha
